sections.value: BROUGHT PURSUANT TO ORDER {{order}} AND UNDER THE INHERENT JURISDICTION OF THIS HONOURABLE COURT

LET {{claimantName}} {{claimantAddress}} attend the {{court}}, __ judicial division within 21 days after service of this summons on them, inclusive of the day of such service, cause an appearance to be entered for them to this summons, which is issued upon the application of {{applicantName}} {{applicantAddress}} and who applies that the claimants appear before this honourable court and state the nature and particulars of their claims, either to maintain or to relinquish them in respect of the {{claims}} and to bear the cost of this application.

value:
Use this information to enhance the draft:
Default role is 'Applicant & Claimants', use if not specify.

If there are more than 2 claimants include and enhance draft.

If there are more facts, enhance the draft. eg 'GROUNDS UPON WHICH THIS SUMMONS IS BROUGHT', then you state the facts.

Generally an interpleader summons is 'an Applicant' and 'two Claimants', because the two claimants are saying the property in the applicant's posession belongs to only one of them.

In FCT it is 42 days after service, while in Lagos it is always 21 days after service, unless outside jurisdiction it becomes 42 days.

To be on the safer side, if the state is located on the southern part of Nigeria, use 21 days.

If any of the Claimant's address is outside jurisdiction, then use this clause before the date 'This interpleader summons (or as the case may be) is to be served out of ____ state of nigeria and in the ,  _____ state of nigeria.'

Other information: {{information}}.
